legacy_root.question: What open and recently-closed issues describe a plugin appearing installed while its hooks are unloaded, a marketplace install failing silently, or a skill present on disk but absent from the loaded set — and which of them match a failure this program has already measured locally?

matched_issues.title: [BUG] Plugins show as "(installed)" in marketplace but don't appear in Installed tab
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: SAME-MECHANISM with Codex $schema would require hooks.json parse rejection. Here the tell is contradictory install state (UI installed + 0 installs, state file vs loader). If hooks.json would fire once the loader recognised the install, this is a marketplace/state bug, not a hooks.json unknown-token dump.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Custom marketplace plugin: UI `✔ my-plugin (installed) · 0 installs`; ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json has the entry and cache plugin.json exists; plugin commands and hooks are not available.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: FC-11303 plus marketplace install that can look successful while the runtime set is empty (IMP-0086 / catalog 64308).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Marketplace UI prints '(installed)' and installed_plugins.json contains the entry, but the Installed tab is empty and commands/hooks are not available — a state-file vs loader split, not a keyword coincidence.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open; no maintainer-confirmed root cause in the captured comments.

matched_issues.title: Plugin hooks not loaded from external hooks.json file
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If moving the identical hook command into user settings.json makes it fire, the hook engine works and the defect is plugin-sourced loading (this issue). If settings.json hooks also do not fire, look at PATH/Git-Bash (decoy class) or a process-wide hook disable. Local Codex $schema dumps ALL hooks including settings-level; #16288 settings-level hooks still work — that split keeps this at SAME-SYMPTOM, not SAME-MECHANISM as the $schema incident.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: plugin.json hooks: ./hooks/hooks.json; SubagentStop command never creates /tmp/hook-test.log after Task tool. Workaround: define the same hook in ~/.claude/settings.json — then it fires.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: FC-11303: plugin appears installed but hooks are unloaded; acceptance must be a runtime side effect, not a config-file listing (IMP-0460, TST-0082).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: External hooks.json referenced from plugin.json never executes; the same hook in ~/.claude/settings.json does fire. Multiple independent reporters. This is registration-path failure, not a missing bash.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Still open; comments also describe a loadPluginHooks race.

matched_issues.title: [BUG] User and Organization Skills — Metadata Registered in System Prompt but SKILL.md Files Not Mounted in Container
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: This is a Claude.ai container mount miss, not Claude Code CLI repo-vs-live two-tree drift. SAME-MECHANISM would require the CLI live skill directory to be a container mount that can omit SKILL.md while metadata still lists it. Surface differs (web container vs local trees) → SAME-SYMPTOM.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Claude.ai / Cowork: user and org skills appear in the system prompt available_skills block with paths; corresponding SKILL.md files are not mounted; /mnt/skills/user/ does not exist.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: FC-11329: skill present in one inventory (repo / index) and absent from the runtime skill directory.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: available_skills metadata lists the skill; /mnt/skills/user/ SKILL.md is not on the container filesystem. Metadata-registered vs bytes-mounted.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open; web/Cowork surface, not the CLI plugin loader.

matched_issues.title: Third-party marketplace plugins cannot register skills/commands/agents
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Hooks fire → this is not FC-11303. Skills absent because manifest validation silently skipped skill discovery, not because of two-tree copy drift. SAME-SYMPTOM with FC-11329; SAME-MECHANISM would require the estate's missing live skill to be a plugin.json schema reject.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Third-party marketplace plugin shows installed+enabled; / autocomplete has no plugin prefix commands. Fix: repository and bugs must be strings, not objects. Error only on fresh session start.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Skill files on disk not in the loaded set (FC-11329). Not FC-11303: hooks DO load.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Reporter later named the token: plugin.json repository/bugs as npm objects fail manifest validation; skills/commands/agents never register; hooks and CLAUDE.md still load (different code path).
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed inactive after reporter's own manifest fix; VS Code chat panel still diverged.

matched_issues.title: Plugin skills not discovered when .claude/ directory exists in plugin
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Local FC-11329 is two-tree drift (repo vs live skill directory). This issue is one plugin tree whose discovery root flips from skills/ to .claude/skills/ when .claude/ exists. SAME-MECHANISM would require the estate's 'missing from live directory' to be this discovery-root flip. On this worktree the local class is repo-vs-live copy, so SAME-SYMPTOM only. Closed inactive, not verified-fixed.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Plugin with .claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/my-skill/SKILL.md + .claude/settings.json; install; reload-plugins does not load skills/; remove .claude/ from plugin cache; reload-plugins loads pluginName: prefix.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: FC-11329: skill exists in repo but not in live skill directory (FAILURE-MODES.json, seeded_classes.py, catalog 42569 / 42578).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: skills/my-skill/SKILL.md is on disk; /reload-plugins does not load it iff plugin contains .claude/; deleting .claude/ from cache makes the same SKILL.md load. That is a discovery-path switch, not a missing file.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed for inactivity; not a confirmed fix.

matched_issues.title: [BUG] /plugin marketplace update silently fails to upgrade installed plugin — no error when skills don't load
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If plugin.json and marketplace.json versions already agree and the cache still serves the old tree, this is update-does-not-refresh-install (this issue), not plugin.json-wins-version (RES-0008 / #54280). The 0-skills/0-hooks reading while the plugin is listed as loaded is the FC-11303/FC-11329 symptom; the mechanism is stale install cache, not $schema parse rejection.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Install plugin; author pushes v1.0.0 → v1.1.0; marketplace update prints success; reload-plugins shows plugin loaded with 0 skills / 0 hooks; install says already installed.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Marketplace path that can look green while the live plugin set is stale or empty; local RES-0008 is a different silent-green (version field precedence), IMP-0086 is install handoff.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: /plugin marketplace update reports success; /reload-plugins lists the plugin as loaded; skills, agents, and hooks registered count is 0; re-install says already installed. Closed as duplicate of #14061.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed as duplicate; captured comments are bots, not a fix commit.

matched_issues.title: plugin.json silently overrides marketplace.json version with no warning
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: SAME-MECHANISM if, when the two files disagree, the installed/displayed version string equals plugin.json and marketplace.json is ignored with no warning. If the client honoured marketplace.json, or warned, this would not match RES-0008. Distinct from #46594 (cache not refreshed) and from #60725 (validate-green / install-red).
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Disagree the two version fields; installed/displayed version is the plugin.json value; marketplace.json version is inert. Real-world: nfrith/als 0.1.0-beta.28 vs 0.1.0-beta.1.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: RES-0008 question: does plugin.json still silently WIN over the marketplace entry for version — commits without a version bump ship nothing while both files pin 0.2.0 (WORK-UNIT-CATALOG 63997).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Named reproduction: plugin.json version 0.1.0-beta.28 vs marketplace.json 1.0.0; Customize panel shows 0.1.0-beta.28; no warning at add, install, or `claude plugin validate`. That is the RES-0008 trap, not a generic install failure.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed stale; this worktree did not re-run a live Claude Code binary. The GitHub reproduction is the second rail, not a local binary trace.

matched_issues.title: `claude plugin validate` does not validate per-plugin `plugin.json` — invalid plugins pass validation, fail at install with opaque temp-cache error
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Install DOES error (opaque), so this is not a silent successful install. It is a silent-green validate. Distinct from #46594 (update prints success and loads 0 skills with no error) and from #54280 (install succeeds, wrong version, no warning).
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Invalid plugin.json author:string passes validate; install errors naming ~/.claude/plugins/cache/temp_local_* not the source file. Reporter links this to #54280 as the same validator blind spot.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Marketplace tooling that can look successful while the plugin will not actually install; related to RES-0008's silent version win because validate does not look at plugin.json.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: `claude plugin validate` is green on marketplace.json only; install then fails on plugin.json with a temp-cache path. False-green validate, not a quiet successful install.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed; install is not silent — only validate is.

matched_issues.title: Plugin-sourced hooks.json never fires, even though the plugin shows installed + enabled (no error, no registry entry evidence)
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Same symptom (plugin looks installed; zero plugin hooks fire) but the rejected token differs: Codex $schema (unknown JSON key) vs Claude Code PreSkill (unknown event name). SAME-MECHANISM would require observing that a $schema key also dumps Claude Code's hooks.json, or that Codex also dumps the file on an unknown event name. That cross-client experiment is not in this corpus. Also isolating: settings.json-level hooks DO fire (#75972 reporter and maintainer), so the dispatch engine is not dead — only plugin-sourced hooks.json registration is.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Plugin installed and enabled; cached hooks.json byte-identical to source; PreToolUse/Bash hook that should block `--no-verify` does not run. Maintainer: PreSkill is not a supported event; one unrecognised event name currently rejects the entire hooks.json; failure only visible in --debug and as 'failed to load' in `claude plugin list`.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Estate: a $schema key in hooks.json made Codex load ZERO hooks while the plugin/config still looked installed (TST-0082, IMP-0039, WORK-UNIT-CATALOG 79764 / 42621).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Maintainer reproduction (bcherny, 2026-08-17) names the token: one unrecognised event name PreSkill causes the entire hooks.json to be rejected, so SessionStart/Stop/PreToolUse/PostToolUse never fire, while skills/agents still work and the plugin shows installed+enabled.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open as of fetch. Local precedent is Codex, not Claude Code. Do not cite as measured same-mechanism.

matched_issues.title: Plugins: enabled-in-settings but never installed loads nothing silently; marketplace autoUpdate never updates existing installs
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If installed_plugins.json lacks a row for the project path, absence of hooks/skills is never-installed, not hooks.json-rejected. The autoUpdate half is SAME-SYMPTOM as #46594 (clone refreshes, install does not). Distinct from RES-0008 version-field win: versions need not disagree for this to bite.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Commit enabledPlugins + extraKnownMarketplaces; new repo has no install record; plugin skills/hooks absent with no warning. autoUpdate:true advances marketplace lastUpdated; install records stay pinned (independent Windows reproduction in comments).
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Declared-enabled / looks-configured vs actually loaded (FC-11303) and marketplace update that does not move the live install (IMP-0086 class).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: enabledPlugins in project settings without an installed_plugins.json row for that path: skills and hooks silently absent, no auto-install. Second bug: marketplace autoUpdate refreshes the clone but never updates existing installs.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open; two bugs in one ticket — do not collapse them.

matched_issues.title: SEEDED CONTROL: plugin appears installed while a $schema key in hooks.json unloads every hook
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If hook scripts remain registered in the client's hook table and fail only at spawn (ENOENT/PATH), this is not FC-11303. FC-11303 requires the hook table itself to be empty or the hooks.json parse to have been rejected while the plugin still appears installed.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Add $schema to hooks.json; plugin remains listed as installed; hook side-effect count is 0.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Catalog TST-0082 / IMP-0039: a $schema key in hooks.json made Codex load ZERO hooks while everything looked installed.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: The seeded body requires a $schema key that unloads every hook while installed_plugins.json still lists the plugin — the same token the estate already measured on Codex.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: This row is the operator-seeded detector control, not a GitHub issue. It proves the search retrieves a known-present record.

non_matches.discriminating_observation: YAML frontmatter hooks on SKILL.md/agent files are ignored; the same command in plugin hooks/hooks.json DOES fire. Plugin-level hooks are loaded, so this is not FC-11303 (plugin installed, hooks unloaded).

matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Still open; comments also describe a loadPluginHooks race.

matched_issues.title: [BUG] User and Organization Skills — Metadata Registered in System Prompt but SKILL.md Files Not Mounted in Container
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: This is a Claude.ai container mount miss, not Claude Code CLI repo-vs-live two-tree drift. SAME-MECHANISM would require the CLI live skill directory to be a container mount that can omit SKILL.md while metadata still lists it. Surface differs (web container vs local trees) → SAME-SYMPTOM.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Claude.ai / Cowork: user and org skills appear in the system prompt available_skills block with paths; corresponding SKILL.md files are not mounted; /mnt/skills/user/ does not exist.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: FC-11329: skill present in one inventory (repo / index) and absent from the runtime skill directory.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: available_skills metadata lists the skill; /mnt/skills/user/ SKILL.md is not on the container filesystem. Metadata-registered vs bytes-mounted.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open; web/Cowork surface, not the CLI plugin loader.

matched_issues.title: Third-party marketplace plugins cannot register skills/commands/agents
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Hooks fire → this is not FC-11303. Skills absent because manifest validation silently skipped skill discovery, not because of two-tree copy drift. SAME-SYMPTOM with FC-11329; SAME-MECHANISM would require the estate's missing live skill to be a plugin.json schema reject.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Third-party marketplace plugin shows installed+enabled; / autocomplete has no plugin prefix commands. Fix: repository and bugs must be strings, not objects. Error only on fresh session start.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Skill files on disk not in the loaded set (FC-11329). Not FC-11303: hooks DO load.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Reporter later named the token: plugin.json repository/bugs as npm objects fail manifest validation; skills/commands/agents never register; hooks and CLAUDE.md still load (different code path).
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed inactive after reporter's own manifest fix; VS Code chat panel still diverged.

matched_issues.title: Plugin skills not discovered when .claude/ directory exists in plugin
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Local FC-11329 is two-tree drift (repo vs live skill directory). This issue is one plugin tree whose discovery root flips from skills/ to .claude/skills/ when .claude/ exists. SAME-MECHANISM would require the estate's 'missing from live directory' to be this discovery-root flip. On this worktree the local class is repo-vs-live copy, so SAME-SYMPTOM only. Closed inactive, not verified-fixed.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Plugin with .claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/my-skill/SKILL.md + .claude/settings.json; install; reload-plugins does not load skills/; remove .claude/ from plugin cache; reload-plugins loads pluginName: prefix.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: FC-11329: skill exists in repo but not in live skill directory (FAILURE-MODES.json, seeded_classes.py, catalog 42569 / 42578).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: skills/my-skill/SKILL.md is on disk; /reload-plugins does not load it iff plugin contains .claude/; deleting .claude/ from cache makes the same SKILL.md load. That is a discovery-path switch, not a missing file.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed for inactivity; not a confirmed fix.

matched_issues.title: [BUG] /plugin marketplace update silently fails to upgrade installed plugin — no error when skills don't load
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If plugin.json and marketplace.json versions already agree and the cache still serves the old tree, this is update-does-not-refresh-install (this issue), not plugin.json-wins-version (RES-0008 / #54280). The 0-skills/0-hooks reading while the plugin is listed as loaded is the FC-11303/FC-11329 symptom; the mechanism is stale install cache, not $schema parse rejection.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Install plugin; author pushes v1.0.0 → v1.1.0; marketplace update prints success; reload-plugins shows plugin loaded with 0 skills / 0 hooks; install says already installed.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Marketplace path that can look green while the live plugin set is stale or empty; local RES-0008 is a different silent-green (version field precedence), IMP-0086 is install handoff.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: /plugin marketplace update reports success; /reload-plugins lists the plugin as loaded; skills, agents, and hooks registered count is 0; re-install says already installed. Closed as duplicate of #14061.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed as duplicate; captured comments are bots, not a fix commit.

matched_issues.title: plugin.json silently overrides marketplace.json version with no warning
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: SAME-MECHANISM if, when the two files disagree, the installed/displayed version string equals plugin.json and marketplace.json is ignored with no warning. If the client honoured marketplace.json, or warned, this would not match RES-0008. Distinct from #46594 (cache not refreshed) and from #60725 (validate-green / install-red).
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Disagree the two version fields; installed/displayed version is the plugin.json value; marketplace.json version is inert. Real-world: nfrith/als 0.1.0-beta.28 vs 0.1.0-beta.1.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: RES-0008 question: does plugin.json still silently WIN over the marketplace entry for version — commits without a version bump ship nothing while both files pin 0.2.0 (WORK-UNIT-CATALOG 63997).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Named reproduction: plugin.json version 0.1.0-beta.28 vs marketplace.json 1.0.0; Customize panel shows 0.1.0-beta.28; no warning at add, install, or `claude plugin validate`. That is the RES-0008 trap, not a generic install failure.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed stale; this worktree did not re-run a live Claude Code binary. The GitHub reproduction is the second rail, not a local binary trace.

matched_issues.title: `claude plugin validate` does not validate per-plugin `plugin.json` — invalid plugins pass validation, fail at install with opaque temp-cache error
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Install DOES error (opaque), so this is not a silent successful install. It is a silent-green validate. Distinct from #46594 (update prints success and loads 0 skills with no error) and from #54280 (install succeeds, wrong version, no warning).
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Invalid plugin.json author:string passes validate; install errors naming ~/.claude/plugins/cache/temp_local_* not the source file. Reporter links this to #54280 as the same validator blind spot.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Marketplace tooling that can look successful while the plugin will not actually install; related to RES-0008's silent version win because validate does not look at plugin.json.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: `claude plugin validate` is green on marketplace.json only; install then fails on plugin.json with a temp-cache path. False-green validate, not a quiet successful install.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Closed; install is not silent — only validate is.

matched_issues.title: Plugin-sourced hooks.json never fires, even though the plugin shows installed + enabled (no error, no registry entry evidence)
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: Same symptom (plugin looks installed; zero plugin hooks fire) but the rejected token differs: Codex $schema (unknown JSON key) vs Claude Code PreSkill (unknown event name). SAME-MECHANISM would require observing that a $schema key also dumps Claude Code's hooks.json, or that Codex also dumps the file on an unknown event name. That cross-client experiment is not in this corpus. Also isolating: settings.json-level hooks DO fire (#75972 reporter and maintainer), so the dispatch engine is not dead — only plugin-sourced hooks.json registration is.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Plugin installed and enabled; cached hooks.json byte-identical to source; PreToolUse/Bash hook that should block `--no-verify` does not run. Maintainer: PreSkill is not a supported event; one unrecognised event name currently rejects the entire hooks.json; failure only visible in --debug and as 'failed to load' in `claude plugin list`.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Estate: a $schema key in hooks.json made Codex load ZERO hooks while the plugin/config still looked installed (TST-0082, IMP-0039, WORK-UNIT-CATALOG 79764 / 42621).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: Maintainer reproduction (bcherny, 2026-08-17) names the token: one unrecognised event name PreSkill causes the entire hooks.json to be rejected, so SessionStart/Stop/PreToolUse/PostToolUse never fire, while skills/agents still work and the plugin shows installed+enabled.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open as of fetch. Local precedent is Codex, not Claude Code. Do not cite as measured same-mechanism.

matched_issues.title: Plugins: enabled-in-settings but never installed loads nothing silently; marketplace autoUpdate never updates existing installs
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If installed_plugins.json lacks a row for the project path, absence of hooks/skills is never-installed, not hooks.json-rejected. The autoUpdate half is SAME-SYMPTOM as #46594 (clone refreshes, install does not). Distinct from RES-0008 version-field win: versions need not disagree for this to bite.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Commit enabledPlugins + extraKnownMarketplaces; new repo has no install record; plugin skills/hooks absent with no warning. autoUpdate:true advances marketplace lastUpdated; install records stay pinned (independent Windows reproduction in comments).
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Declared-enabled / looks-configured vs actually loaded (FC-11303) and marketplace update that does not move the live install (IMP-0086 class).
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: enabledPlugins in project settings without an installed_plugins.json row for that path: skills and hooks silently absent, no auto-install. Second bug: marketplace autoUpdate refreshes the clone but never updates existing installs.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: Open; two bugs in one ticket — do not collapse them.

matched_issues.title: SEEDED CONTROL: plugin appears installed while a $schema key in hooks.json unloads every hook
matched_issues.discriminating_observation: If hook scripts remain registered in the client's hook table and fail only at spawn (ENOENT/PATH), this is not FC-11303. FC-11303 requires the hook table itself to be empty or the hooks.json parse to have been rejected while the plugin still appears installed.
matched_issues.upstream_reproduction: Add $schema to hooks.json; plugin remains listed as installed; hook side-effect count is 0.
matched_issues.local_reproduction: Catalog TST-0082 / IMP-0039: a $schema key in hooks.json made Codex load ZERO hooks while everything looked installed.
matched_issues.why_not_keyword_only: The seeded body requires a $schema key that unloads every hook while installed_plugins.json still lists the plugin — the same token the estate already measured on Codex.
matched_issues.strongest_caveat: This row is the operator-seeded detector control, not a GitHub issue. It proves the search retrieves a known-present record.

non_matches.discriminating_observation: YAML frontmatter hooks on SKILL.md/agent files are ignored; the same command in plugin hooks/hooks.json DOES fire. Plugin-level hooks are loaded, so this is not FC-11303 (plugin installed, hooks unloaded).
non_matches.title: [BUG] Skill and agent frontmatter hooks silently not firing (CLI, Windows)

non_matches.discriminating_observation: Reporter states /reload-plugins reports 0 skills while invocation of skills/*/SKILL.md works in the same session. The skill is in the loaded set; the counter only tallies commands/*.md. FC-11329 requires the skill to be absent from the loaded set, not miscounted.
non_matches.title: /reload-plugins reports 0 skills for plugins using skills/*/SKILL.md (count only, invocation works) — 2.1.220

non_matches.discriminating_observation: Reporter closed it: directory-source marketplaces run hooks against the live source tree, not the cache dir; the canary was written to the cache, which the hook never executes. Instrumentation error, not unloaded hooks.
non_matches.title: Plugin hooks never run when the plugin is installed from a directory-source marketplace

non_matches.discriminating_observation: Title has plugin+installed+hooks, but hooks are registered and fail at spawn because Git Bash is missing from PATH. FC-11303 requires an unloaded hook table, not ENOENT on bash.exe.
non_matches.title: Windows: plugin installed but hooks fail because Git Bash was not found
